bioconda.name: tau-glymphatic-continuum
bioconda.summary: Multiscale reaction-diffusion and perivascular glymphatic clearance engine for Alzheimer's tau spreading.

biotools.summary: A multiscale reaction-diffusion and perivascular transport computational engine modeling pathological Tau propagation in Alzheimer's disease. Parameterized from clinical DTI-ALPS diffusion indices, Stokes-Brinkman perivascular hydrodynamics, and microglial neuroinflammatory strain across multi-center cohorts.
